source_scope_exclusions.reason: refresh-only generated integrity outputs; containing them would create a digest cycle (README.md remains in source scope)
refresh-only source map, current-state, handoff, and machine-readable mirrors
immutable validation/review evidence may be added after source validation and is hash-indexed separately
Git internals and nontracked operational/private material are outside the tracked source scope

freshness_rule: Recompute the complete declared source scope, separately indexed evidence, and stable live-ledger snapshot. Any mismatch is stale; current full HEAD/tree are reported separately because generated/evidence-only commits may follow this source revision.
